name: Zulki Crown
source:
Zulki Crown is Zeth's Secretary of Finance and the leader of the northern city of Italia.

A member of the prestigious noble Crown family, Zulki is living a privileged life. He takes full advantage of his position as secretary of finance by extorting money from lower class citizens in order to increase his own wealth. During his free time, he often capture second-class Zeth women and brutally torture and sexually abuse them.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Zulki_Crown]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
